page.notes: Greek running head read as ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ; first letters are doubtful. Page number read as 92. Long s printed as f-like shape in "sobriis", "suffragiis", "asfentiri", "confensisse", "perspexerim", "difpendio" etc.; transcribed as plain s. "prospi-ceretur" line-end word is hard to read. Catchword "minus" is the next line's first word. Bottom-left mark read as signature "e" with uncertainty. Printed text is not corrected (e.g. "Dignus est qui... poteft").
